dashboard.label: Vendor-Sim Compliance Matrix
dashboard.description: Simulated vendor-grade AI security telemetry — illustrates the shape of a commercial AI security platform's output. Fully synthetic lab data, not real Cisco AI Defense. Uses sourcetype acme:agentic:vendorsim:json.

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local count=0 /services/apps/local MachineLearningToolkit | head 1 | eval has_mltk=1

`acme_vendorsim_index` $global_time$ | `acme_vendorsim_crosswalk_enrich` | eval is_variance=if(isnull(framework_severity) OR framework_severity="" OR (isnotnull(finding_type) AND finding_type="UNKNOWN"), 1, 0) | stats sum(is_variance) AS variance_count

panel.title: Runtime threats by vendor-sim objective boundary

search.query: `acme_vendorsim_index` earliest=-7d@d latest=now | eval objective_boundary=coalesce(vendorsim_objective, 'cisco_threat_taxonomy.objective', "UNMAPPED") | stats count AS threat_count by objective_boundary | sort -threat_count

panel.title: Compliance ledger — vendor-sim x framework crosswalk

search.query: `acme_vendorsim_index` $global_time$ | `acme_vendorsim_crosswalk_enrich` | `acme_vendorsim_token_normalize` | eval event_time=coalesce(cisco_event_timestamp, otel_event_time, strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")) | table event_time event_id transaction_id agent_name finding_type policy_action threat_category lookup_objective lookup_technique lookup_subtechnique owasp_classification mitre_atlas_id framework_severity input_tokens output_tokens total_tokens matched_indicator scan_target | rename event_time AS "Event Time" event_id AS "Event ID" transaction_id AS "Transaction ID" agent_name AS "Agent" finding_type AS "Finding Type" policy_action AS "Policy Action" threat_category AS "Threat Category" lookup_objective AS "Vendor-Sim Objective" lookup_technique AS "Vendor-Sim Technique" lookup_subtechnique AS "Vendor-Sim Subtechnique" owasp_classification AS "OWASP LLM Class" mitre_atlas_id AS "MITRE ATLAS ID" framework_severity AS "Framework Severity" input_tokens AS "Input Tokens" output_tokens AS "Output Tokens" total_tokens AS "Total Tokens" matched_indicator AS "Matched Indicator" scan_target AS "Scan Target" | sort - "Event Time"

panel.title: GenAI token forecast (CTSM) — 14d window intentional override

search.query: `acme_vendorsim_index` earliest=-14d@d latest=now | `acme_vendorsim_token_normalize` | timechart span=1h sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens | fit MLTKContainer algo=ctsm_forecast total_tokens holdback=24 period=24 future_timespan=48 into forecast_total_tokens

html.p: Install Splunk Machine Learning Toolkit to enable the Cisco Time Series Model forecast panel. Token usage timechart still works without MLTK.
